text: The draft 2017 Audited Consolidated Financial Statements and Report have been prepared by Welch LLP and are presented to the Board of Directors for approval. These statements provide separate fund accounting for both the City of Toronto and the Province of Ontario endowment funds.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved $6.1 million as the Toronto Stabilization Fund balance for 2017, and zero for the Ontario Stabilization Fund balance. 2. Approved the 2017 Audited Consolidated Financial Statements.
